# Device State Console v3.0.178

## Device group management and atomic membership sync

- Extend `PUT /api/devices/group` with optional `removeDeviceIds` so adding members, removing members back to ungrouped, renaming a group, and dissolving a group run atomically inside one MySQL transaction or local store write, broadcasting `device:update` for every affected instance.
- Enforce a 64-code-point limit, reject control characters, and reserve `"未分组"` in `validateDeviceGroupName` so custom group names cannot shadow the built-in ungrouped bucket.
- Route Web write actions through `runWrite` so `401`/`403` immediately marks the session expired and group/order/rename mutations bypass the offline snapshot throttle to persist straight into `OfflineSnapshotCache`.
- Add zero-group onboarding, status-cell multi-select checkboxes with header select-all and `Shift+Click` range selection, floating batch action bars, inline clickable group badges, cross-group drag-and-drop onto group headers and sidebar groups, dual-mode `BatchGroupManageDialog` (preserving checked selections across status/ungrouped filters), and full rename/dissolve parity on touch Web.

## Pooled group visualizations

- Aggregate byte-weighted memory and disk capacity pools (`usedBytes / totalBytes`), normal online counts, and peak CPU/memory/disk/GPU hotspot devices per group in `selectDeviceGroups`.
- Promote the group scope filter to the top of Overview, driving scoped KPIs, attention lists, a 5-cell pooled group telemetry strip, an Overview group comparison Bento grid, and a group-aggregated vs. per-device trend chart mode (defaulting to grouped curves when named groups exist across more than 6 devices, with 1-click legend drill-down).
- Decouple group sections from within-group sorting in the device directory and add grouped table, card swimlane, and flat table view modes.

## Console layout, dialog, and formatting fixes

- Render `M3Dialog` via a `document.body` portal with a themed scrim, avoiding `[open]` effect re-runs that stole focus or interrupted CJK IME composition; add fixed `<colgroup>` widths in `M3DataTable` so columns align across expanded groups; fix double `history.back()` navigation when closing `TouchSheet` actions.
- Fix unit boundary promotion (`1023.96 KB → 1.0 MB`, `999.96 Mbps → 1 Gbps`, `119.6 min → 2 h 0 m`), multi-device chart hover tolerance (`2500ms`), physical memory chart visibility on Linux/macOS agents without commit-charge metrics, pre-hydration dark-theme sync, sticky device context headers, and `44px`/`48px` coarse-pointer and touch targets.

## Validation

- Source and package versions are synchronized at 3.0.178.
- Server suite: 250 tests (235 pass, 15 skipped, 0 failed); Web/PWA: 60 tests; workspace contracts: 99 tests; UI helpers & adapter contracts: 16 tests.
- `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm verify:version`, adapter/UI boundary checks, visual regression suites, and the tagged release/package gates run in GitHub Actions.

This is a test-channel prerelease for v3.0.178.
